reason.amendment001Status: Amendment 001 established unit/arm status model, progress, and adapter fairness. Amendment 002 specifies the integrated runner, centralized outer model, provider metering, mechanical arm derivation, and all F1-F17 requirements.

armStatusDerivation.rule: Derive mechanically from unit statuses. All measured → MEASURED. Measured plus failed/unavailable → PARTIAL_FAILED. Failed with no measured units → FAILED. All unavailable → NOT_MEASURED. Explicitly excluded arm → EXCLUDED.
armStatusDerivation.partialFailedEligibility: PARTIAL_FAILED arms are not rank eligible but retain all measured units in raw evidence.

applicability.rule: Product capabilities are harness metadata, not LLM output fields.

userIsolation.reason: null for SUPPORTED | non-empty string for NOT_APPLICABLE

persistence.reason: null for SUPPORTED | non-empty string for NOT_APPLICABLE

userIsolation.reason: decision records have a native project namespace but no native user namespace
decision records have a native project namespace but no native user namespace
product exposes project namespaces but no native user namespace
control has no memory system or native user namespace

noMemoryRules.measurableMetrics: decision quality, latency, outer model usage remain measurable

operationMetrics.memoryReadOperations: Count of native memory retrieval operations
operationMetrics.memoryWriteOperations: Count of native memory write/persist operations
operationMetrics.outerDecisionModelCalls: Count of common outer decision model requests
operationMetrics.persistenceVerificationOperations: Count of verification probes (separate from scored operations)
operationMetrics.rule: Report exact non-negative integer counters. No generic 'toolCalls' hiding multiple native operations. Verification operations kept separate unless explicitly combined by amendment.

schema.blockedClaims: list of claims unavailable storage blocks

rules: Exact byte scope must be defined
Unsupported storage = null with NOT_AVAILABLE reason
Do not report fake zero bytes for Neo4j or external stores
Do not use response JSON size as database storage size

definitions.truthfulZeroResult: Zero-measured output reports the actual recorded cause (endpoint unavailable, adapter invalid, infrastructure failure, contract failure, operator interruption), not a generic missing-model reason when model capability was available.

progress.flushRule: flush and fsync the progress record before the next unit begins
progress.unitEvidence: write unit_finished or unit_failed before starting next unit
progress.retention: Never delete, replace, zero-fill, or rerun-substitute a completed or failed unit

interruption.attemptId: unique identifier for each execution attempt
interruption.runId: unique identifier for each logical run
interruption.operatorInterruption: recorded in progress log as run_interrupted
interruption.historicalSeparation: The historical 20260830T180000Z-comparative run remains separate and INCOMPLETE_NOT_MEASURED

watchdog.policy: Uses monotonic elapsed time and most recent heartbeat/checkpoint timestamp. Lack of stdout alone is never a stall diagnosis.
watchdog.runTimeoutPolicy: No benchmark-wide timeout imposed; operator may stop, progress log records interruption

integratedRunner.rule: One integrated candidate runner uses Amendment 002, validator, aggregator, scorer, checkpoint writer, watchdog, centralized model client, metering layer, and implementation lock.
integratedRunner.aggregatorRequirement: Calculate real results for valid complete arms. Must not remain a placeholder returning empty arrays.
integratedRunner.acceptanceMode: Same runner with scored:false, no score/ranking/marketing fields in output

centralOuterModel.ownership: The harness, not adapters, owns outer decision model
responsibilities: model name, seed, temperature, token limits, timeout
centralOuterModel.adapterProhibition: Adapters must not independently call the outer decision model

providerMetering.rule: Product-internal LLM and embedding calls must be metered via local proxy or equivalent
capture: input/output tokens where provider metadata exists
providerMetering.blockingPolicy: Unavailable token metrics block only related claims, not entire measurement

phaseAGroundTruth.rule: Common Phase A prompt provides every option/ID needed by scoring, equally for all arms
forbidden: filling missing model fields from expected answers
giving one adapter hidden fixture truth
preloading products with expected answer before Phase A
phaseAGroundTruth.storage: Store only the standardized answer generated by common decision model

result.nativeContext: array of native record objects only
result.persistenceEvidence: null or exact record-specific evidence with namespace
result.isolationEvidence: null or exact alternate-namespace leak evidence

requirements: expose internal provider traffic to metering

shadowgraphSpecific.scopes: use the native project scope for decision records; native user isolation is NOT_APPLICABLE unless a native user-scoped record API is proven; never concatenate user ID into project
shadowgraphSpecific.verification: verify expected record after fresh server load

mem0Specific.phaseAOrder: Phase A model answer must precede persistence
mem0Specific.verification: exact expected records after fresh load

graphitiSpecific.storage: may be null only under approved NOT_AVAILABLE policy

basicMemorySpecific.phaseAOrder: do not write Phase A expected record before model answer
basicMemorySpecific.userIsolation: declare native user isolation NOT_APPLICABLE if using adapter directories without product feature

cogneeSpecific.providerMode: use one consistent OpenAI-compatible localhost mode for both model families, not native Ollama mixed with /v1
prohibitions: store full expected fixture before Phase A

reproducibility.insufficient: 'latest' alone, or Ollama Docker image digest without model-weights digest

reviewBundle.byteIdentical: Source, tests, preregistration, amendments, and lock files must be byte-identical to tested files
reviewBundle.sanitizationScope: Only runtime config values, logs, reports
reviewBundle.secretRemoval: Remove credentials from source by design, not during bundling

candidateAcceptance.gate: All seven arms must pass according to declared applicability before any scored run

greenGates: all seven arms pass non-scored acceptance
repository diff contains no secrets/private paths
